properties.name: Terra Indica
properties.principle: The Indian subcontinent to its continental margin, with Sri Lanka and the Himalaya: the Indian plate's land and seas, ending at the Chaman fault (ZR22), the Indus–Yarlung suture (ZR21) and the Indo-Burman ranges' western foot (ZR22).
